blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Education (DepEd) has included mathematics and introduced flexible tutoring into its flagship Academic Recovery and Accessible Learning (ARAL) Program. According to a statement issued on Wednesday, DepEd made the move to build on the gains the Philippines made in the 2025 Programme for International Student Assessment (PISA). It broadens the program to improve not only foundational reading but also core numeracy skills of students in grades 1 to 10.
